pages.body:
The shop takes orders from shoppers and charges their cards through a payments service.[^1]

See the [payment domain](madarch:domain:payment) for how a charge happens.

[^1]: [payments](madarch:code.service:payments), [UC-2](madarch:doc:docs/requirements.md#uc-2)

statements.text: The shop takes orders from shoppers and charges their cards through a payments service.

pages.body:
Payments are charged through one of two providers chosen by configuration.[^1]

Checkout asks payments to authorize the card for the order's total.[^2]

A refund that brings the refunded total up to the captured amount moves the order to refunded.

[^1]: [PaymentClientFactory](madarch:code.symbol:services/payments/src/providers/factory.ts#PaymentClientFactory), [a function that is not there](madarch:code.symbol:services/payments/src/providers/factory.ts#NoSuchFactory)
[^2]: [UC-2](madarch:doc:docs/requirements.md#uc-2), [PaymentService.pay](madarch:code.symbol:services/payments/src/domain/payment-service.ts#PaymentService.pay)

statements.text: Payments are charged through one of two providers chosen by configuration.
Checkout asks payments to authorize the card for the order's total.
